sources: Actual production startup/accounting/container ports and approved native-installation task; no private evaluation grant.

boundaries.cold: Fixed typed manifest/profile recipe, explicit intended account/model/effort and immutable source; no JSON callable/import/argv/verdict.
boundaries.authority: Permission to attempt from a trusted actual controller/admission supplier is distinct from real observed native startup. Missing normal authority refuses; no file/signature becomes execution or billing proof.
boundaries.commands: Real existing DockerCommands/ContainerPlan through exact task/attempt/resource/deadline/spec wrapper. No raw shell or unconstrained host process runner.

cases.oracle: Cold source resolves the declared authorized profile read-only and constructs real native policies/HostInvocationAccounting only from typed current authority.
Missing/revoked/wrong account/model/source/role authority refuses before provider/assigned work; default Claude profile or model/account fallback is never selected.
Unknown JSON import/callable/passed/argv fields, unsafe/symlink/copied manifest and unsupported profiles refuse.
Registered command checks exact task/attempt/resources/source/environment/capability/deadline and delegates only configured references through existing confined runner.
Omitted registration, foreign worktree/task, stale source, replay/lost result and unresolved shutdown do not cause duplicate command execution.
Installed owner consumes built-in cold resolver and configured command registry without changing public run/resume schemas.
Authored controls remain labeled; actual model/provider/Docker reproduction is staged separately and unrun without Root admission.

limits.children: only owned credential-free authored control children if selected; no CASE10/private packet access
